discovery.interpretation: Conditional failure-removal gains overlap and are not additive causal OEE shares. Bounded model targets use the least parameter change recovering 90% of the best isolated tested gain, then test joint packages. Screening is preliminary; full-horizon independent confirmation is required. Intervention feasibility, cost and CAPEX classification remain unassigned.

interpretation: Bounded exploratory targets, three-round screening and independent three-round eight-hour confirmation. No supplier, maintenance or economic feasibility claim. Not a global optimum.
